title: Hacker stole personnel data about thousands of Homeland Security employees, including CBP and ICE agents | TechCrunch
summary: The data also contains records associated with another 10,000 employees of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and its Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) unit, and just under a 1,000 employees who work at U.S. cybersecurity defense agency CISA.
